syncDevices.title: Sync devices
syncDevices.intro: Every phone or tablet that uses the same sync code shares the same data. It syncs whenever the internet is on.
syncDevices.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
syncDevices.qrLabel: QR code to join this device's data
syncDevices.qrHint: On the other device, scan this QR code with the camera, or type the code under "Join another device".
syncDevices.secretWarning: Anyone with this code can see and add to this data. Share it only with staff you trust.
syncDevices.joinLabel: Join another device: enter its sync code
syncDevices.invalid: Enter the full sync code shown on the other device
syncDevices.same: This device already uses this sync code.
syncDevices.confirmMessage: This device will receive all data from that workspace. Data already on this device will be added to it too. Only join a workspace of your own shop or clinic.
syncDevices.joined: Joined. Data from the other devices arrives whenever the internet is on.
syncDevices.failed: Could not join. Please try again.
syncDevices.localOnly: Sync is not set up for this app, so data stays on this device only. Everything still works offline.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: The app hit a problem. Your data is safe on this phone.
